machine: Freddy: A Nightmare on Elm Street (Gottlieb, 1994)

shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: The skill shot here is one of the three ways to fall asleep and start a nightmare, so your very first plunge can put you straight into the fight.

shots.name: Boiler Room
shots.notes: The single most important shot on the machine. It awards the 1... 2... mystery while you are awake, it is what finishes a nightmare once the Freddy Meter is full, and it pays kruegerands and 10,000,000s inside the right multiballs.

shots.name: Captive Ball
shots.notes: Strobes when you are fully awake. It is also where the last multiball jackpot moves to once the other four are collected, and where the glove flipper is aiming.

shots.name: Captive Ball Spot Target
shots.notes: Sits in front of the captive ball. Lit by the left return lane it starts the combo feature; hit while fully awake it awards Freddy's Bones.

shots.name: T.V. Set
shots.notes: Starts flashing out once lit. Hit it while it flashes and it pays 10,000,000 multiplied by how many you have hit in succession, so this is a shot to repeat rather than visit once.

shots.name: Glove Flipper
shots.notes: A small flipper by the lower left kicker. When it is qualified, a ball arriving at that kicker is handed to you to flip off the ramp yourself.

shots.name: Lower Left Kicker
shots.notes: Where Dream Warriors is started once all three jackpot lamps are lit, and where the glove flipper takes over if it is qualified.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers
shots.notes: Each hit adds 300,000 to your end-of-ball bonus, or a full 1,000,000 when the bumpers are flashing. Shooting through them is also the route to Freddy's head.

shots.name: Freddy's Head
shots.notes: Flashes for one shot after a lit right return lane. Reaching it means shooting through the pop bumpers, and making it opens the shop where kruegerands get spent.

shots.name: Take That Target
shots.notes: The top left target. What it awards depends on how long games have been running on this machine — see the Take That goal.

shots.name: Upper Left Spot Target
shots.notes: The last resting place of the Dream Warriors strobing shot. Once the strobe lands here it stays, so this becomes a repeatable super jackpot.

shots.name: Centre Left Spot Target
shots.notes: Worth nothing special most of the game — but hit it while you are fully awake and it awards the Hidden Mode.

shots.name: Save Soul Targets
shots.notes: Nightmares start with one or all of these lit depending on which nightmare you are in. Souls collected here are banked and paid out later.

shots.name: Lower Left Target
shots.notes: Flashes for an add-a-ball during any nightmare that has multiball running. Easy to miss because everything else is flashing too.

shots.name: Top Left Gate
shots.notes: Opened by the combo feature. It is the door that lets the combo jackpot shot happen.

shots.name: Left Return Lane
shots.notes: Scores 30,000, and while lit it arms the captive ball so the combo feature can be started.

shots.name: Right Return Lane
shots.notes: Worth 30,000, and when lit it arms the kruegerand trade at Freddy's head.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Worth 3,000 and carries the kick save when it is lit — which the Take That target is often the way to light.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: Worth 3,000, and flashes for a special if you are having a bad game — start your last ball under 20,000,000 and it lights for a timed period.

shots.name: Slingshots
shots.notes: Only 30 points each, but every hit performs the toggle function, flipping some game features on and others off behind the scenes.

shots.name: Sleep / Awake Meter
shots.notes: A vertical billboard in the upper centre. Time pushes it down toward asleep and coffee shots push it back up. Both ends of the meter do something to you.

goals.title: Plunger Skill Shot
goals.summary: The plunge is one of only three ways into a nightmare — the others being the mystery award from the boiler room and simply running out of time. Taking it here means you choose when the fight starts rather than having it chosen for you.
goals.reward: Straight into a nightmare

steps.detail: Landing it drops you straight into the next nightmare — on your own terms, with whatever items you have already earned rather than whatever you happen to be holding when the sleep meter simply runs out.

goals.title: Awake And Asleep
goals.summary: The whole machine runs on two states. Awake is normal play, where you gather items and points. Asleep is a nightmare, where you fight Freddy. Understanding what carries between the two is the difference between surviving nightmares and being fed to them.
goals.reward: The structure of the game
instructions: You start every game awake. Three things put you to sleep: the plunger skill shot, the 1... 2... mystery from the boiler room, and time running out on the sleep meter.
During a nightmare, shoot any flashing FREDDY shot. Each one steps the Freddy Meter billboard forward two places.
When the meter is full the boiler room qualifies. Shooting it defeats Freddy for 10,000,000 times the nightmare number and wakes you up.
If multiball is still running when you defeat him, you stay in multiball and the jackpots light instead.
There are seven nightmares in the ladder. Each one starts with a different combination of multiball, lit Save Soul targets and an active Freddy jackpot.
The first time you play each nightmare the game is kinder — it hands you free items and a partly filled Freddy Meter. Repeats do not get that help.

goals.title: Defeat Freddy
goals.summary: Inside a nightmare, every flashing FREDDY shot pushes the meter two places along — three if you brought more power in with you. Fill it and the boiler room lights. Shoot it and he goes down for 10,000,000 times the number of the nightmare you are in.
goals.reward: 10M x nightmare number

steps.detail: Nightmares open with one or all Save Soul targets lit, so take whatever is already flashing rather than hunting a favourite shot.
Every flashing shot counts the same, and with more power banked each one is worth three places instead of two.
The boiler only qualifies once the meter is complete.

goals.title: Earn Your Items While Awake
goals.summary: Three items carry from the awake state into your next nightmare, and they change it completely. Multiball means the nightmare opens with multiball. More power makes every Freddy shot worth three meter steps instead of two. Set alarm gives you a way out at the end.
goals.reward: A nightmare you can actually win

steps.detail: The 1... 2... award from the boiler room is random, and it is one of the readier ways to pick items up.
Hit while fully awake, this hands you all three next-nightmare items at once — and twenty kruegerands instead if you already hold them.
If the meter is close to the bottom and you have no items, coffee shots buy you the time to collect some.

goals.title: Set The Alarm
goals.summary: The most interesting of the three items. With the alarm set, the boiler room qualifies five seconds before the nightmare ends — and if you grab Freddy there, the nightmare carries on into the awake state instead of simply expiring.
goals.reward: A nightmare that continues past its own clock

steps.action: Have a shot ready for the last five seconds
steps.detail: The window is short and the boiler only lights right at the end.
Success means the nightmare continues while you are awake — the best of both states at once.

goals.title: Coffee And The Sleep Meter
goals.summary: The vertical billboard in the upper centre is a clock you can push back. Time drives it toward asleep; coffee shots drive it toward the top. Both ends matter — the bottom drops you into the next nightmare, the top makes you Fully Awake and unlocks two hidden awards.
goals.reward: Fully Awake, which arms Hidden Mode and Freddy's Bones

steps.action: Watch which way it is moving
steps.detail: Left alone, it only ever falls.
Every coffee shot pushes the meter up toward Fully Awake.
When the captive ball starts strobing you have reached the top, and Hidden Mode is now qualified.

goals.title: Hidden Mode
goals.summary: Reach Fully Awake and then shoot the centre left spot target. You get a multiball where every boiler room shot pays a flat 10,000,000 and it runs until you are back to one ball. You only ever get one of these per player per game, so make it count.
goals.reward: 10,000,000 per boiler shot

steps.action: Climb the meter to the top
steps.detail: Nothing about Hidden Mode is available until you are fully awake.
This is the award — the target does nothing special otherwise.
Every single shot is 10,000,000, so keep at least one ball trapped and shoot deliberately.

goals.title: Freddy's Bones
goals.summary: The other Fully Awake award, and the one that changes your next nightmare. While you are fully awake, the spot target in front of the captive ball hands over all three next-nightmare items at once — or twenty kruegerands, if you already hold all three.
goals.reward: Multiball, more power and set alarm together

steps.detail: The captive ball strobing is your cue.

steps.action: Hit the spot target, not the captive ball
steps.detail: It is the target in front of the captive ball that carries this award.

goals.title: Multiball Jackpots
goals.summary: Defeat Freddy while multiball is still running and five jackpot lamps start flashing. Each shot collects its jackpot and puts that lamp out. Keep going and eventually only one is left — and that last one moves to the captive ball, where it stays active.
goals.reward: Five jackpots, then a repeatable one

steps.action: Beat him without losing the multiball
steps.detail: The jackpots only light if you are still on more than one ball when he goes down.
Each collection turns its own lamp off, so track what is left rather than shooting the same place twice.
The final shot relocates there and stays live, which makes it the shot to camp on.

goals.title: The Nightmare Add-A-Ball
goals.summary: Any nightmare that is running with multiball flashes the lower left target for an extra ball into play. It is easy to overlook with everything else lit, and it is the cheapest way to keep a nightmare multiball alive long enough to finish it.
goals.reward: One more ball in play

steps.detail: It only flashes during a nightmare that already has multiball going.

steps.action: Then get back to the meter
steps.detail: More balls means more flashing FREDDY shots per second, which is how the meter fills fast.

goals.title: The Combo Jackpot
goals.summary: A three-part chain and one of the three lamps you need for Dream Warriors. Roll the left return lane to qualify the captive ball, hit the spot target while it is lit, and that opens the top left gate and briefly flashes the centre jackpot — complete it for the combo jackpot.
goals.reward: Combo jackpot and one of three lamps

steps.detail: This is what qualifies the captive ball for the combo.

steps.action: Hit the spot target while lit
steps.detail: The top left gate opens and the centre jackpot starts flashing for a short window.

steps.action: Complete it before the window closes
steps.detail: The timer here is short — have the shot planned before you hit the spot target.

goals.title: Dream Warriors
goals.summary: Light all three jackpot lamps — one multiball jackpot, one Freddy jackpot and one combo jackpot — and the lower left kicker qualifies for Dream Warriors. Inside it, the strobing shot pays a super jackpot and then moves, until it settles on the upper left spot target and stays there.
goals.reward: Repeatable super jackpots

steps.action: Collect one of each jackpot type
steps.detail: Any multiball jackpot, any Freddy jackpot and any combo jackpot lights its own lamp.

steps.action: Start it at the lower left kicker
steps.detail: The three lamps together are what qualify this hole.
Each super jackpot moves the strobe somewhere new, until it reaches the upper left spot target and stops moving. It runs until you drop out of multiball.

goals.title: Bank Kruegerands
goals.summary: Kruegerands are the game's currency. Plenty of features hand them out, each one is worth a million in the Final Nightmare, and leftovers you never spend still pay you in the end-of-game bonus. Kruegerand Multiball builds a pile fastest.
goals.reward: Currency for the shop and 1M each at the end

steps.action: Shoot the boiler door in Kruegerand Multiball
steps.detail: Every boiler door shot is worth five kruegerands, and the multiball lasts until you are back to one ball.

steps.action: Take Freddy's Bones when you are stocked up
steps.detail: If you already hold all three next-nightmare items, Bones pays twenty kruegerands instead.

goals.title: Freddy's Shop
goals.summary: Roll the right return lane while it is lit and Freddy's head flashes for one shot — through the pop bumpers. Make it and you can spend kruegerands. What is on offer depends entirely on how many you are holding, so it pays to wait rather than shop early.
goals.reward: Souls, multiball, extra balls or Dream Warriors

steps.detail: The right return lane has to be lit for this to work at all.

steps.action: Shoot the head through the pops
steps.detail: One shot only, so do not waste the light on a wild attempt.
10 to 19 kruegerands buys 10 souls, 20 to 29 buys Kruegerand Multiball, 30 to 39 a hurry-up extra ball, 40 to 49 a straight extra ball, and around 50 or more buys Dream Warriors outright.

goals.title: Take That
goals.summary: The top left target hands out different things depending on how long games have been lasting on the machine. On a fast machine it gives you saves first; on a slow one it just pays points. Either way it is the most reliable way to relight your kick save.
goals.reward: Kick save, claw save, hurry-up extra ball or up to 20M

steps.action: On a fast machine, take the saves
steps.detail: When the average game is under three minutes the ladder runs kick save, then claw save, then a hurry-up extra ball, and finally 20,000,000 once you have taken two hurry-up extra balls.

steps.action: Cash the kick save where it lives
steps.detail: The kick save sits on the left outlane.

steps.action: On a slow machine, expect points
steps.detail: When the average game is over three minutes it pays 5,000,000, then 10,000,000, then a hurry-up extra ball.

goals.title: Arm The Claw Save
goals.summary: Complete C-L-A-W and you can activate the claw device that sits between the flippers — the one thing on this playfield that catches a ball headed straight down the middle. Once you use it the letters reset and you start again.
goals.reward: A save between the flippers
instructions: Collect all four C-L-A-W letters to make the claw available.
The claw is a physical device between the flippers, so it covers the drain the flippers cannot.
Activating it resets C-L-A-W, so treat it as a resource you rebuild rather than one you keep.
The Take That target will also light the claw save directly if your kick save is already lit.

goals.title: The T.V. Set
goals.summary: Once lit, the television starts flashing out, and hits during that flash pay 10,000,000 multiplied by how many you have landed in succession. That multiplier is the point — one hit is fine, four in a row is a different game entirely.
goals.reward: 10M x consecutive hits

steps.action: Hit it while it is flashing out
steps.detail: The award only pays during the flash.
Each consecutive hit raises the multiplier, so set up a repeat rather than moving on.

steps.action: Collect the bonus in a nightmare
steps.detail: When the set flashes during a nightmare it collects your bonus instead.

goals.title: The Glove Flipper
goals.summary: Qualify the glove and the lower left kicker stops being a hole that just spits the ball back — instead you get to flip the ball off the ramp yourself. Land it on the captive ball and the game pays you for it.
goals.reward: An award for hitting the captive ball off the glove

steps.action: Arrive at the kicker with the glove qualified
steps.detail: If it is not qualified the kicker simply behaves normally.
You control this flipper, so wait for the ball rather than swiping at it.
That is the target that pays.

goals.title: The Final Nightmare
goals.summary: The end of the ladder, and it always opens as a four-ball multiball. Five strobing shots qualify the boiler room, and the boiler finishes him. The payout adds up everything you have hoarded all game — souls, kruegerands and every Freddy you have already put down.
goals.reward: 1M per soul, 1M per kruegerand, 10M per Freddy defeated

steps.detail: If multiball ends before you finish them, the game gives you a grace period rather than cutting you off.
The boiler only qualifies once all five strobing shots are down.
Souls and kruegerands you never spent are each worth a million here, so hoarding through the game pays off in one shot.

goals.title: The Low Game Special
goals.summary: A quiet mercy rule. Start your last ball with under 20,000,000 and the right outlane lights for a special for a timed period. It is the one time in this game that a right drain is something you might actually aim for.
goals.reward: Special at the right outlane

steps.action: Check the outlane on your last ball
steps.detail: It only lights if your score is low when the ball starts, and it is on a timer.
You do not need a clean shot here, just to stop fighting the right side for a moment.

goals.title: Build The Bonus In The Bumpers
goals.summary: Every pop bumper hit adds 300,000 to your end-of-ball bonus, and 1,000,000 each when the bumpers are flashing. That makes time in the bumpers genuinely productive rather than dead time waiting for the ball to come back.
goals.reward: 300K per hit, 1M when flashing

steps.detail: Shots through this area toward Freddy's head keep passing through them.
A flashing bumper is worth more than three ordinary hits.

achievements.title: Straight To Sleep
achievements.desc: Enter a nightmare directly from the plunger skill shot.

achievements.title: One Down
achievements.desc: Fill the Freddy Meter and finish a nightmare at the boiler room.

achievements.title: Beat The Clock
achievements.desc: Grab Freddy in the last five seconds with the alarm set.

achievements.title: Wide Awake
achievements.desc: Push the sleep meter all the way to Fully Awake.

achievements.title: Hidden Mode
achievements.desc: Take the centre left target while fully awake for the 10,000,000 boiler multiball.

achievements.title: Freddy's Bones
achievements.desc: Collect all three next-nightmare items in a single hit.

achievements.title: Five Lamps Out
achievements.desc: Collect all five multiball jackpots after defeating Freddy.

achievements.title: Through The Gate
achievements.desc: Run the left return lane, spot target and gate chain for a combo jackpot.

achievements.title: Dream Warriors
achievements.desc: Light all three jackpot lamps and start Dream Warriors at the lower left kicker.

achievements.title: Spending Spree
achievements.desc: Bank 40 or more kruegerands and buy an extra ball at Freddy's shop.

achievements.title: Must-See Television
achievements.desc: Land consecutive T.V. Set hits to multiply the 10,000,000 award.

achievements.title: The Final Nightmare
achievements.desc: Complete all five strobing shots and finish him at the boiler.

drills.title: Choose When You Fall Asleep
drills.text: The plunger skill shot is one of only three ways into a nightmare, and the only one you control. Practise taking it deliberately, so the fight starts while you are holding items rather than whenever the sleep meter happens to run out.

drills.title: Boiler Room Reps
drills.text: Every nightmare ends at the boiler and most of the game's awards are collected there, so drill it cold from both flippers. It is the one shot you cannot afford to be hunting for when the Freddy Meter fills.

drills.title: One Shot At The Head
drills.text: Roll the lit right return lane and Freddy's head flashes for exactly one shot, reached by shooting up through the pop bumpers. Set the shot up properly rather than throwing it away on a wild swing, because the light does not wait.

drills.title: Wait Out The Glove
drills.text: With the glove qualified, the lower left kicker hands you the ball to flip yourself. Let it come all the way onto the glove before you press — the target that pays is the captive ball, and a swipe sends it anywhere else.

drills.title: The Three-Part Combo
drills.text: Left return lane to qualify the captive ball, spot target while it is lit, then the centre jackpot through the gate that just opened. The last window is short, so pick that third shot before you take the second.

drills.title: Keep Hitting The Set
drills.text: The television only pays while it is flashing out, and the award multiplies by how many you have landed in succession. Set up a repeat off the return rather than taking one hit and wandering off to something else.

actionButton.how: There is no third button to press — Freddy is a 1994 Gottlieb, so flippers, plunger and nudge cover everything. Its unusual controls live on the playfield instead: the claw between the flippers that catches balls once you have spelled C-L-A-W, and the glove flipper by the lower left kicker that gives you a swing at the captive ball.

howItPlays.objective: Freddy's table swings between being awake, where you stockpile items and currency, and asleep in a nightmare, where you battle Freddy at the boiler room. Work up the ladder of seven nightmares and hoard souls and kruegerands for a huge Final Nightmare payout.
loop: Fall asleep one of three ways -- the plunge skill shot, the boiler-room mystery, or the sleep meter draining to the bottom -- to drop into a nightmare.
Inside a nightmare, hit any flashing FREDDY shot to step the meter billboard forward, then finish him at the boiler for ten million times that nightmare's number.
While awake, farm the three carry-in items and a pile of kruegerands, and push the meter all the way to Fully Awake for its two hidden awards.
Bank one jackpot of each type to qualify Dream Warriors, and hoard souls and kruegerands to cash them all at once in the Final Nightmare.

lights.name: Freddy Meter
lights.lit: Inside a nightmare every flashing FREDDY shot counts the same and steps the meter billboard two places, or three if you carried extra power in with you.
lights.flashing: A shot only flashes while a nightmare is running; awake, these same shots do other jobs entirely.
lights.then: Fill the meter and the boiler room qualifies -- shoot it to put Freddy down for ten million times the nightmare's number and wake up. Beat him while a multiball is still going and you stay under with the jackpots lighting instead.

lights.name: Sleep Meter
lights.lit: The billboard in the upper center reads how awake you are, and left alone it only ever slides toward sleep, so coffee shots at the boiler are what push it back up.
lights.flashing: The captive ball strobing is the tell that you have hit the top and are Fully Awake.
lights.then: Hitting bottom sends you into the next nightmare; reaching the top arms two awards -- the center-left target for Hidden Mode, a boiler multiball paying a flat ten million a shot, and the captive-ball spot target for Freddy's Bones. Hidden Mode is a once-per-game gift, so set it up.

lights.name: Save Soul Targets
lights.lit: Nightmares open with one or all of these targets lit, and the souls you collect on them bank away for a big payout much later.
lights.then: Down Freddy with a multiball still alive and five jackpot lamps light, and the last one relocates to the captive ball and stays live to camp on. Every banked soul is worth a million when the Final Nightmare tallies up.

lights.name: Combo Jackpot Chain
lights.lit: Rolling the left return lane arms the captive-ball spot target, and hitting that target while it is lit throws the top-left gate open and flashes the center jackpot for a brief window.
lights.then: Drive the ball through the opened gate before the window shuts to bank the combo jackpot, which also lights one of the three Dream Warriors lamps you are gathering. Pick that last shot before you hit the spot target, because the timer is short.

lights.name: Dream Warriors Lamps
lights.lit: Three lamps track one jackpot of each kind -- a multiball jackpot, a Freddy jackpot and a combo jackpot -- and each stays lit once you have banked its type.
lights.then: All three together qualify the lower-left kicker for Dream Warriors, where a strobing super jackpot leaps to a new shot each time you collect it until it settles on the upper-left target and holds. From there it is a repeatable super until you drop out of multiball.

lights.name: Freddy's Shop
lights.lit: The right return lane arms the trade, which flashes Freddy's head for a single shot reached by going up through the pop bumpers.
lights.then: Make the head to spend your kruegerands, and what is on the shelf scales with how many you hold -- ten buys souls, twenty a Kruegerand Multiball, forty a straight extra ball, and around fifty buys Dream Warriors outright. It pays to wait and shop rich rather than early.

lights.name: T.V. Set
lights.lit: Once lit the television flashes out, and only a hit landed during that flash pays, ten million times however many you have strung together in a row.
lights.then: Line up a second hit off the return instead of striking once and moving on, because the multiplier is the entire point and four straight is a wholly different score from one. Should the set flash mid-nightmare, the hit banks your end-of-ball bonus rather than points.

scoring.text: Take the plunge skill shot so you enter a nightmare holding your own items rather than whatever you happen to have when the sleep meter runs out. While awake, farm the boiler mystery for carry-in items and feed the pops to build an end-of-ball bonus worth keeping.

Beat nightmares at the boiler, drive the meter to Fully Awake for Hidden Mode and Freddy's Bones, and stack kruegerands while lighting one jackpot of each kind for Dream Warriors. Relight your saves off the Take That target so a middle drain or an outlane does not end the run.

The Final Nightmare opens as a four-ball multiball where five strobing shots qualify the boiler, and finishing him tallies everything you hoarded -- a million per soul, a million per kruegerand and ten million per Freddy already beaten. Dream Warriors' repeatable supers are the other top-end score.
